name: How long does a whole-home remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole-home remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole-home remodel varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. A small to mid-sized remodel might take 3-6 months, while extensive renovations involving structural changes or additions could extend to 8-12 months or more. Key factors influencing the timeline include design finalization, permit acquisition, material lead times, and the coordination of trades. Our team works to establish a realistic timeline upfront and keeps you informed throughout each phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: A whole-home remodel can take anywhere from 3 months to over a year, depending on the project's size, complexity, and factors like permits and material availability.
